watches.name: RIM Diamond - 01 BK
watches.description: DESIGNED FOR THOSE WITH DRIVE Our most popular timepiece and the original Mazzucato, this timepiece has been crafted with the aim of connecting the luxury automotive world with stunning watch design. With these two worlds intertwining so naturally, our RIM Sport chronograph watch keeps up with you, no matter how quickly things move. Showcasing a stainless-steel case and Double Domed K1 Glass with Antireflective Coating, the RIM Sport feels like luxury, crafted with care. Our brand-defining commitment to technical excellence means that our premier collections all showcase our distinctive mechanism: the Reverse Industrial Movement. This system allows the case to be inverted fully in both directions. The quick-release catch discharges the crown from its protector and the case can rotate freely, transforming the look of your watch and how you use it. TIME-ONLY DIAL The time-only face of the watch shows a dial covered by an authentic car rim. The three hands (hour, minutes, seconds) are powered by a high quality Japanese automatic movement. CHRONOGRAPH DIAL When it’s time to switch up your look, simply rotate the watch face to the chronograph side. Instant style. Fast. SPECIFICATIONS Diamond Quantity: 120PCS Spoke Case Diameter: 48 mm Case Thickness: 19.6 mm Case Material: Stainless Steel 316 L Glass: Double Domed K1 Glass with Antireflective Coating (Both Sides) Strap: Double Compression FKM Plating: Grade A IPB (0.6 Mic Tic ±20%, PVD) Water Resistance: 5 ATM Crown: Push In With Double O-ring 3h Automatic Movement: Miyota 9015 Stopwatch Quartz Movement: Miyota Js 00 Rim Face Function: 3 Hands Auto Chrono Face Functions: Center Second Hand, 12h Counter (60 Sec Chrono), 4h Counter (30 Minute Chrono), 8h Counter (24h Indicator)

watches.name: RIM GT - GT7-GR - Automatic Watch Ø42mm
watches.description: Sculpted For Speed One of our newest collections and the smaller cousin of our RIM Sport, the RIM GT is a sport chronograph watch with bite. Its muse is still the high-end supercar world, much like its predecessor, the RIM GT is designed for the fast lane. With flat K1 glass and two layers of anti-reflective coating, this timepiece talks the talk and walks the walk. Smaller, lighter and more affordable than the RIM Sport, this watch allows you to experience the Mazzucato brand with Seiko NH 70 Automatic Skeleton Movement and a power reserve of 41 hours. Aluminium and Luminox hands make viewing the dial easy and the spring bar strap allows for simple strap change over. watches.name: RIM SUB - Yellow/Black SK4-YL - Automatic Dive Watch
watches.description: Dive Watch, Reinvented The SUB is a diving watch, reimagined. Scuba’s smaller cousin and a great introductory watch to launch your love affair with the Mazzucato brand. Our brand-new dive watch is water-resistant, up to 10 ATMs, with Skeleton NH70 automatic movements and a massive 42 hours of power reserve. The stylish design and bold dial give every diver a legible timepiece, even in low light and poor visibility. Our precision functionality comes from the uni-directional turning bezel with luminous enamel insert and the SUB’s ultra-scratch-resistant k1 glass includes a firefly toon coating on the bot side. Smaller, lighter and more affordable than its Scuba predecessor, you can experience all the technology you expect in a dive watch, Skeleton NH70 automatic movements and an affordable casing. Specifications Case Diameter: 42mm Water Resistance 10 ATM Skeleton NH70 automatic movements with 42 hours of power reserve Precision functionality from the uni-directional turning bezel with luminous enamel insert. Ultra scratch-resistant k1 glass with a firefly toon coating (bot side) FKM Bicolour Strap

watches.name: RIM Monza - F1-GY361 - Chronograph Watch Ø48mm
watches.description: Time To Thrill The Monza is our most extreme timepiece to date. Boasting a carbon fibre case and a new, sporty design, the Monza is the perfect watch for anyone wanting to stand out from the crowd. With bold styling and renowned Miyota movements, our Monza collection gives you all the technology you need, offering a fresh take on our classic Mazzucato sport chronographs. Our brand-defining commitment to technical excellence means that our premier collections all showcase our distinctive mechanism: the Reverse Industrial Movement. This system allows the case to be inverted fully in both directions. The quick-release catch discharges the crown from its protector and the case can rotate freely, transforming the look of your watch and how you use it. Time-Only Dial The time-only face of the watch shows a dial covered by an authentic car rim. The three hands (hour, minutes, seconds) are powered by a high quality Japanese automatic movement. Chronograph Dial When it’s time to switch up your look, just rotate the watch face to the chronograph side. Instant style. Fast. Specifications Case Diameter: 48 mm Case Thickness: 19.6 mm Case Material: Carbon Fiber Glass: Double Domed K1 Glass with Antireflective Coating (Both Sides) Strap: Double Compression FKM Buckle: Stainless Steel 316 L Plating: Grade A IPB (0.6 Mic Tic ±20%, PVD) Water Resistance: 5 ATM Crown: Push In With Double O-ring 3h Automatic Movement: Miyota 9015 Stopwatch Quartz Movement: Miyota Js 00 Rim Face Function: 3 Hands Auto Chrono Face Functions: Center Second Hand, 12h Counter (60 Sec Chrono), 4h Counter (30 Minute Chrono), 8h Counter (24h Indicator)
